about: Template for the person's own vendors file. Copy it by hand, never into a holon: install -m 600 vendors.sample.json ~/.config/lionsberg/vendors.json. The proxy refuses a vendors file that is a link, not yours, or readable or writable by others. This file alone decides where requests may go and with which key; routes.json only names these vendors.
about_rules: scheme https to a named host; plain http only to an IP that is loopback or this machine's own address (no names). key_env is null or a name starting LIONSBERG_ or ending _API_KEY; a named key that is unset is an error, never a fall-back. Only a vendor of kind anthropic with key_env null passes the client's own key through.
about_allowed_origins: Web origins allowed to call the proxy, e.g. the HUD's own page. Empty: every request carrying an Origin header is refused.

anthropic.about: The Anthropic API. Set key_env to null to pass the client's own key (a Claude Code login) through to this host only.

router.about: An OpenAI-compatible router; requests go to https://host/path/chat/completions.

local.about: A local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama-class) on this machine. The only kind of vendor the private tag may use.
